findings.F1: On down days, the day's high-low range measured against the coin's 60-day average range predicts the 3-day move above drift. The slope of the 3-day strength on the log scaled range is +0.196 (t 3.23, day-clustered, 4746 non-overlapping cases on 680 days). On up days it is −0.052 (t −0.96, 5147 cases on 697 days), so the effect sits on the down side only.
findings.F2: The effect is graded across down-day range quintiles. The mean unusual 3-day move runs −0.55 %, −0.45 %, −0.19 %, +0.46 % and +1.97 %. The top quintile has a strength of 0.22 and t 2.42 on 228 days, so its unusual move is about 9 times the 0.22 % cost of a trade.
findings.F3: The range carries the rebound, not the size of the fall. With both in one regression on down days, the log scaled range has a coefficient of +0.315 (t 4.15) and the scaled fall −0.129 (t −1.94). The tested scaled fall on its own has a slope of −0.022 (t −0.82), and its verdict size is +0.02 % (t 0.10).
findings.F4: What matters inside the range is how far the close sits above the day's low. Measured in the coin's 60-day average range, this lower-wick distance has a coefficient of +0.242 (t 3.17) on down days. Alongside it, the range falls to +0.089 (t 1.37).
findings.F5: Volume shows the same thing but adds nothing beyond the range. The log scaled volume slope on down days is +0.139 (t 3.21), and with range and fall included it drops to +0.031 (t 0.68).

ideas.idea: On a day a coin closes down, the further its close has recovered above the day's low, measured in the coin's average daily high-low range over the past 60 days, the more the coin rises above its normal drift over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A down close with a long lower wick is a reason to buy the coin for a few days, and a down close at its low is a reason to refuse that buy, more firmly the more extreme the wick.
ideas.name: down-day lower-wick rebound

ideas.idea: On a day a coin closes down, the wider that day's high-low range against the coin's average daily range over the past 60 days, the more the coin rises above its normal drift over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A wide-ranging down day is a reason to buy the coin for a few days, and a narrow, quiet down day is a reason to refuse a long, more firmly the further the range sits from usual.
ideas.name: wide-range down-day rebound
